description: Needs sign-in (OAuth, scope watchlist:write). Removes a company (by CIK or ticker) from the companies the reader follows.

cik.description: SEC CIK of the company (search_companies), leading zeros optional, e.g. "320193".

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, e.g. "AAPL" (used when cik is empty).

name: unfollow_company
title: Stop following a company
